reviews.text: Very rude staff, terrible customer service, go to Porter Ranch, the reception young lady needs training she is not with her friends answering questions but at the work place, don't bring your baby's here.

We love CAMP and their mission. When we were down on our luck we were able to get our Chihuahua Pug mix spayed through their low cost program. Today we had our Parson's Terrier mix get a cleaning and extraction done at CAMP's Northridge location and it went flawlessly.

Dr. Segal is an angel and works diligently to make sure that animals in her care are taken care of to the last little detail. Before going into surgery we received multiple status calls and updates from clinic staff. Dr. Segal followed up with us via text and checked in on our sweet boy after-hours. CAMP and their staff go above and beyond. We are so grateful that they server our community and pets with such care and compassion.

We look forward to the day that we can contribute a monthly donation to their cause.

Thank you CAMP 🫶
Great service short lines and good prices 👌 …

The staff can be a little stiff but they warm up. They deal with all kinds of personalities and are always professional, so I get it. They are moving the clinic to the  Northridge petco. I am willing to travel a little further.

The experience was supportive.
Went in early, dropped off my pup with my son who accompanied me for emotional support. The desk attendant
immediately gravitated toward our fur-babe in a loving way and was genuinely kind - you could tell that she loves animals and cares about the experience of the family. I felt that we could trust the process keeping our Lil nugget there for his neuter. In the afternoon we received a call that everything went well and he would be ready to pick up in 45minutes.
Upon returning to pick him up, we were given his medication and instructions on how to care over the next several weeks. Was so comforted to see my lil' guy as he was me. I was so grateful that the process was so efficient professional and caring. They offer very affordable care and voucher if you're eligible. This location is exceptional and I would give 10 stars if I could!! Thanks!!
Great people, and Doctors
Very kind and affordable
I thought the place was excellent, the staff was friendly during my visit and there was good communication.
The attention was good. But the place is a little dirty
amazing, honest services and great pricing.

If you can afford to take your pet anywhere else...PLEASE DO! You get what you pay for! They basically ripped off my puppys nails.  Went here because we got a voucher but I'd rather pay more and have my pet feeling safe. Guy with the septum was so RUDE!
Got my cat vaccinated and spayed

The man at the front desk with the rings and painted nails needs to go through another training process and learn customer service and hospitality. A customer made a friendly joke and the employee rudely " responded you can come back another day if you like". I am part of a big group of rescue and I will tell them all to avoid this spot. Seriously, you need to check your employees. Do better. Without us you have no business.

Our experience was excellent!  The whole process was very efficient.  The staff was knowledgeable and friendly.  The cost was reasonable and they don't try to add on any fees or extra charges.  I would highly recommend getting your pet spayed or neutered at this facility.  I would also recommend donating to their organization.  Keep up the great work!
Very nice and respectful 🙏 …
Good pricing. They accept neutering vouchers as well.

Came to do a walk in to vaccinate my cat. By the time we go up to the desk, they said they were shutting down from 12-2 pm for lunch. What was I supposed to do with my cat that had a panic attack on the way here? Either put on google or your website that you completely shut down for 2 hours every day or have enough staff in rotation so this doesn't happen to these poor animals that have to wait anxiously. It's already difficult enough to try & have them leave their home for this.

My experiences with this place were somewhat disappointing. I chose this place because I trusted the high review, even though I found another place in Burbank more affordable ($110 for cat neuter, with free e-collar).

I called 4 times and was not able to speak to a real person. They made mistakes on both of my kittens’ paperwork, which thankful they called later and showed me that the vaccine and medicine given were actually right.
Their care for your furballs is genuine ...and they are not looking to hustle you to make an extra buck.  They are a blessing for the low income folks.

I got my cat neutered here on 1/16/2026 and everything went great and smooth, my cat is very happy. Very friendly staff. There was a small mistake on their end about refunding the $30 deposit to my card as it was put down I got refunded cash. I called them and Brianna resolved it within a day and got me the refund. Very pleasant, highly recommended, nice and polite staff. Definitely bring your furry family member here. You're in good hands.
Took my cat to get spayed here... She got pregnant again MONTHS later. Upsetting.
They take in stray cats/dogs and they are a kill-free shelter! They are very professional and they really do care about their animals!

Dropped off cats I am fostering for a rescue, both of them are up for adoption.
They had a neuter appointment.

The clinic clipped one of the cat’s ear when they were specifically told NOT to do ear clips.

This is a mistake that SHOULD HAVE NOT HAPPENED and it BETTER NOT HAPPEN AGAIN.

So disappointing.
——

Responding to the clinic’s response:

NO. The cats that I dropped off FOR the rescue were not through the City Program. And if that was the case, BOTH cats would have got the ear clip, NOT just one!

That was an ERROR from the doctor or whoever did this.
The Rescue which I’m fostering for CONFIRMED they never EVER get their cats ear tipped and indeed was YOUR unfixable mistake.
It's a good clinic, they're very fast, they have many services, they're friendly and professional, you can see that clients always come back and the prices are the best I found.
Wonderful experience for the third time! They answered all my questions and took great care of my little kitty “Brave”!
Thank you for your support and help. Great team.God Bless you. ❤️ 🐕 My Mia dogibaby said rour you the best. …
My dog loves going, like why but he does
Took good care of my 14 year old cat. Had some teeth pulled and had to get sleeping gas.
Friendly staff. Great service. Saw lots of happy pet owners and pets leaving the facility. Walked in with no appointment for vaccinations at the busiest time of day and was out the door after 30 min.
Very professional doctor

I recently brought my 1 year and 3 months old corgi, Wonka, to CAMP LA Mission Hills for his neuter surgery, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! The whole team was absolutely amazing – they provided great support from start to finish and made sure both Wonka and I felt comfortable. The surgery went very smoothly, and I felt reassured by how caring and professional everyone was. On top of that, the price was very affordable compared to other clinics. I’m so grateful for their excellent care – highly recommend this clinic!
It's convenient for me drive around 12 mile but can do all vaccination good prices
Fantastic place, fantastic people, very helpful...

They helped neuter my dog! I have a yellow Labrador retriever. I called around multiple places and every place wanted over $500 with my neuter certificate from the city. CAMP only had me pay $170 for bloodwork and $30 for pain medications and nothing for the neuter. They took great care of my boy and I couldn't be happier. He healed well and they finished him early as I asked. Thank you for providing affordable vet care and caring for my boy!
Excellent place
Good prices, fast service.

PLEASE DO NOT GET YOUR PET SPAYED OR NEUTERED HERE!!!
My dog was neutered recently and they did not send him home with antibiotics. He was having such terrible symptoms a day after like uncontrollably diarrhea vomiting and shaking and they were not answering their phones so I had to take my dog to an emergency vet. As soon as I let the vet know where he was neutered he referred to it as “unsanitary” and “unsafe”. He stated a safe and sanitary neutering clinic would have required Parvo testing prior to doing procedure. I had to get my dog tested for Parvo due to their lack there of. Luckily he was negative but truly a scare. He instead prescribed my dog an antibiotic along with other with other medications to aide with his other symptoms. All in all if you care about the health and safety of your pet please stay away from this place !
I love this place. The staff is super nice and they have taken care of my pets for years.
Very good clinic, excellent service, good prices... thank you
These folks are awesome
I loved this place . The girls were very welcoming & answered all my questions before leaving . Thank you for your great service
Really kind and helpful customer service.

this was a great experience. We qualified for the free voucher from LA for spay/neuter but everywhere we called didn’t except them, we got recommended CAMP mission hills and they accept them so we decided to give them a chance! they also have great prices for low income. We had two male kittens going in for neuter and the staff was great answering all our questions and going the extra mile for the two of them. They did a checkup exam, which I did not know would be included, and found that one of the kittens had a heart murmur. They let us know and did some extra things to make sure he would be safe. I also informed them the other kitten had a bad reaction to his vaccines so they were nice enough to give him a small dosage of Benadryl. The boys are healing great and we will definitely think about taking them back there for anything concerning.

They are so quick friendly clean sweet genuinely kind n loving so very helpful!!
Highly recommended a must go!! God bless them. Raider n I thank the Lord 4 them 2 day!!
CAMP is such an amazing program, especially the one on mission hills. Good affordable prices and offer helpful advice.
I'm so glad I found this CAMP clininc.You walk in fill out your form and your ready for your dog or kitty service..that easy.!!. The staff are so helpful and friendly..

We've been bringing our pets here for about a year and a half, and it's been a great experience overall. Their vaccine prices are very affordable, and their hours are convenient. The staff is generally helpful—some more than others—but given the high volume of patients, occasional hasty or rude interactions are understandable. Despite that, I truly appreciate their hard work and the valuable service they provide to the community.
Very caring and professional services.
Trying to get there for the volunteers but the day i should be there i got sick. I can't wait to do things there with all the cats. Nice people's nice pets & nice place 😘 …
Lovely Accommodating staff. Absolutely amazing with my Kitten. Thankful for their work.
The ladies are very kind and polite and serve you very quickly

I would like to take the time and inform whoever it may concern. This organization is very helpful. The staff all seem very friendly, attentive, and caring. I took my 2 year old cat to get spayed and the process was easy. Visit the website, make a call (I highly recommend joining their waitlist), drop off early in the morning, pick up mid afternoon. Staff is informative, some more than others, but overall very helpful. I also suggest filling the online forms accurately and emailing them directly to the location with your appointment.
I was given a follow up call by Eli who took the time to hear out my concerns and answer my questions. I feel at ease and much more confident in the process.
Efficient, sweet staff, my pup did really well. Highly recommend

i got my cat spayed here, her incision got infected, i took her to a different vet and they told me they did it wrong, it was bleeding and it was open, they also didn’t give me any medication for my kitty, and no cone. i don’t suggest this place to anyone

Absolutely amazing , they were all great and my dog willing went with them inside for his procedure. They were super good at explaining medications and after care and if support was needed after they were there to help.
Got my neutered cat back, and he was freshly bleeding. No cone, and clearly had been left alone to gnaw on the site for at least the hour before I arrived.
Taylor got Spayed here!:)
Enjoy dropping off my baby, feeling very comfortable with you, and knew they would take care of them, my girl's great job and thank you

I've been bringing my sweet little Terrier mix to CAMP for rabies vaccines and wellness checks since we adopted her in 2022. The staff have always been kind and helpful during visits. The facility also has dog friendly landscaping outside.

Camp Clinics should be the poster child for all vets. Even though the staff is extremely busy, they take the time to answer even the simplest question. The staff is awesome, they handle each pet as if it was precious cargo, and they are! The ambiance here is calm. I thought my dog was going to freak out with all the movement and noise. Instead, my dog wanted to play. The facility is clean, no animal smell and they really know their stuff. I would highly recommend this clinic for spay/neuter surgery (my doggie had this) or just for regular vet services. They are more affordable than my old Vet and the vaccines are definitely worth the price. Keep up the great work!

Took my 2 kittens to get neutered and they came back infested with fleas. They took no accountability and the only thing they had to say was to go buy their flea medication. I’ve tried to call and get an explanation but trying to reach them is impossible.
Great experience. Staff was professional and nice.
This place is amazing. The staff is very knowledgeable and my pups scored free microchips for their 4 th of July event in June. Thank you!
Good price. Easy to make an appointment.

Terrible experience. They gave my cat the 3 in 1 shot and he had a bad reaction. What was supposed to be normal side effects, lasted over 5 days and when I called they insisted it had nothing to do with the vaccine and basically told me not to waste my time coming back because they’d just tell me to go to the ER. We ended up taking him to another vet and they were appalled by how CAMP LA handled my boy. some cats have reactions to vaccines and need a shot beforehand to prevent these things so insisting it had to be something else was highly unprofessional and they knew they were wrong. ALL PROFESSIONALS KNOW CATS CAN HAVE REACTIONS JUST LIKE HUMANS CAN TO VACCINES. But instead they wanted to avoid any kind of responsibility, and I don’t even understand why because it’s not like they make the vaccines. But they should be responsible for checking on the pet after the shots. It blows my mind that they wouldn’t even talk to me directly the manager sent someone that is not even part of this clinic to call me and tell me not to come after I was told to come back the first time.
I will NEVER come back here, and to think I was going to let them neuter him as well. I understand coming to this place may be your only option, but if you can, PLEASE spend money on a good vet. You truly get the service you pay for. Cheap service with people who don’t care as much as they portray.
What can I say every time I’ve had the pleasure to use their services it’s been great they are super easy to work with and understanding and treat the pets very well
Good employees unfortunately you end up waiting to being seeing for some time do to the short staff they have
CAMP CLINIC MISSION HILLS KILLED OUR CAT AND PUSHED US TO SIGN A CONSENT FORM OF US GIVING THEM PERMISSION TO PUT OUR CAT DOWN!! DON'T COME HERE IF YOU WANT MEDIOCRE SERVICE!!
Great help! Fast service! Very friendly and informative
Good service
Took my dog there because I guess he had fleas they did an exam which I didn't really see anything beneficial for me because it was not really a report but the team was really nice.
I've brought my cats here to get spayed and neutered, it has been amazing. I'm so  happy I can trust this place .
Adorable animals
Excellent service. Thank you.
The very BEST. People are kind and my puppy now 1 year old dog loves them and has no fear of the vet so I know they treat her well.

I researched so many places to take my frenchie to get spayed and found CAMP from the ASPCA website. I was incredibly nervous to get my dog spayed as it is a higher risk surgery for frenchies but the staff reassured me that the vets are trained with Brachycephalic breeds. They also take extra precautions and administer additional meds to help minimize potential risk. So far, 3 days post op my frenchie is doing great and I would highly recommend this clinic-not just for the affordability but the care that seemed to be placed upon my pet!

This place is amazing !!! The staff are very friendly and very helpful with every questions I had before bringing my Frenchie home to recovery from his surgery. I’m definitely bringing my other dog here for her surgery.
